literal_meaning: চিবানোর উপযোগী এবং চোষার উপযোগী (chewable and suckable)
example_sentences_in_bangla: পার্টিতে চর্ব্য-চোষ্য সব ছিল, সবাই খুশি হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Today, excellent and delicious dishes were prepared at home.
The party had sumptuous food, and everyone was delighted.
